## Fixed
- **The wrong download was being offered for Minecraft 26.1.x.** Since v0.3.0, some players installing or updating on 26.1.x were handed a build made for Minecraft 1.21.11 by mistake. It refused to load, with an error saying the mod required Minecraft 1.21.11 — on both Fabric and NeoForge. Those files had been published under the wrong Minecraft version, so launchers picked them up as the newest 26.1.x download. This release supersedes them, and the 1.21.11 files are now labelled correctly.

## Notes
- No gameplay changes — this build is identical to v0.3.1. It exists only to correct the downloads.
- If v0.3.1 loaded fine for you, nothing changes. If it refused to load, this fixes it.
- This was a packaging mistake, not a problem with your setup.
